## **Source-file header (private phase)**

Add to the top of each source file:

```text
# Copyright (c) 2025 the SADIE Project. All rights reserved.
# Confidential and proprietary. No license granted except by written agreement.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-Proprietary
```

When the Project is released publicly, replace the proprietary header with the
chosen open-source `SPDX-License-Identifier` and update this notice.
